standard: shampoo-classification-v1.6.1 candidate (lane-a scrubbed copy); not a locked policy id

formulaBlock.normalization: ID-2: 'Aqua/Water/Eau' one entry; colour entries one each; 47 normalized entries; normalized positions

cleansingStrength.rationale: strong by C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 with a prominent reinforcing strong anionic Sodium Laureth-8 Sulfate @4 (C3b ether/sulfonate class); buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine @5. C3b laureth-8 limit: read as a buffer the chassis would be moderate, so confidence at most moderate, neighbor moderate. Ether sulfates @13, @14, @15, @19 are after the E3 point and not counted.

conditioningLevel.rationale: low: cleansing-led; the only conditioning polymer is Polyquaternium-10 @21, after the E3 point; no silicone, no payload lipid; PEG-3 Distearate @6 is a pearlizer. Counter-signal: polymer plus pearlizer could give light slip; neighbor moderate.

reset: strong anionic ether Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2, Sodium Laureth-8 Sulfate @4
excluded: Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer @12 (anionic acrylate thickener, 6.4)

wLineRecord.note: Climbazole @7 is not a candidate (rinse-off limit 2 %). Piroctone Olamine @8: (i) surfactants before; (ii) only Phenoxyethanol @9 before the cap. No payload_lipid in the formula.

weightPotential.counterevidence: Polyquaternium-10 can deposit at low dose.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: A single late light cationic polymer (@21) faces a strong reinforced ether-sulfate chassis; no silicone, lipid, protein or film former.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: moderate needs a plausible persistent depositing system; one late Polyquaternium-10 against strong reset is not one (single family, W2).
weightPotential.rationale: low: one late light polymer vs strong reset (6.6, W2).

careDirection.limitation: formula-only; no repair or moisture cluster

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Two recognized dandruff actives (Climbazole @7, Piroctone Olamine @8) make scalp_active the formula-compatible candidate with dandruff positioning; Caffeine @20 is never a focus route (F5).
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind pass: claim direction null; provisional general.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered; no claims visible.

usageRole.rationale: provisional regular: treatment if a qualifying dandruff claim appears (U3); alternating if reset intent (U4, strong); frequent impossible while strong.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: not_targeted regardless of positioning: CSA fails, no E4 comfort or humectant/refatting route before the E3 point @10 (Allantoin @18, Niacinamide @29 are not prominent; Propylene Glycol is not listed); strong cleansing counter-signal.

dandruffSupport.rationale: supported: Climbazole @7 and Piroctone Olamine @8 in a complete formula (Section 11).

strongAnionicEther: Magnesium Laureth Sulfate @13, Magnesium Laureth-8 Sulfate @14, Sodium Oleth Sulfate @15, Magnesium Oleth Sulfate @19 (not prominent)
surfactantClasses.c4: defining SLES @2; reinforcing Sodium Laureth-8 Sulfate @4; buffer CAPB @5

uncertainties: cleansingStrength strong vs moderate hinges on Sodium Laureth-8 Sulfate @4 as a strong anionic (C3b); moderate confidence, neighbor moderate.
